goals.title: Batch 1 - Measurement integrity
goals.objective: Implement only the Batch 1 scope from the master plan, prove every immediate acceptance criterion, start additive dual-write collection, schedule the full-market-cycle reconciliation check, and do not mark complete until that later gate is proved.

goals.title: Batch 2 - Exact trade tracking
goals.objective: After Batch 1 is complete, implement exact options-contract and share tracking, prove reproducible quotes, costs, fees, missing-data states, and rollback as defined in the master plan.

goals.title: Batch 3 - Safety and scoring correctness
goals.objective: After Batches 1 and 2 are complete, prove structured prices, delivery truth, public privacy, source independence, contribution totals, and safe rollback.

goals.title: Batch 4 - Speed and reliability
goals.objective: After correctness is stable, measure and improve the named command and data paths without weakening evidence, then prove time limits and failure containment.

goals.title: Batch 5 - Clean observation sample
goals.objective: Collect and report at least 20 trading days and 100 independent resolved recommendations, prove every integrity threshold, and restart any contaminated clean window.

goals.title: Batch 6 - Ranking experiments
goals.objective: After a clean sample exists, preregister and test simple ranking methods chronologically with the latest 30 percent untouched and every promotion metric reported.

goals.title: Batch 7 - Shadow daily ranking
goals.objective: After a ranking passes internal gates, run and verify silent daily ranking without changing owner-visible output, including safe rollback.

goals.title: Batch 8 - Controlled release
goals.objective: After every promotion gate passes, stage the owner-visible digest, prove automatic safety stops and saved-delivery agreement, never automate orders, and schedule the 20-trading-day review.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ultragoal plan in .omx/ultragoal/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omx/ultragoal/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
